people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

people.name: Luz
people.line: A Canaanite city; a man built another city named Luz

translations.web: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.
translations.bsb: And the man went to the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.
translations.kjv: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
translations.asv: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz, which is the name thereof unto this day.
